summary: If you burn on 10 Oct at 2:00 pm, smoke will likely reach:
Government Health Centre (clinic) by about 2:20 pm
Dental Care Hospital (hospital) by about 2:25 pm

Burning 5 acres burns about 10.2 tonnes of straw and releases about 64 kg of PM2.5; the most reaches Kiran Nursing Home: about +20 µg/m³ of PM2.5 (AQI there 500, severe, mostly PM10, largely desert dust).
